summary: Tested Opportunities appointment location dropdown logic. All features working correctly: Physical Location shows address field, Online Meeting shows SaySMe checkbox with secure room name + URL preview, Other Meeting URL checkbox with custom URL input. Backend PUT /api/leads/{id} returns appointment_notifications_sent field. No regression in existing sections (Tasks, Notes, Payments, Associated Objects).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminLeadsKanban.jsx: buildSecureSaysmeRoomName() generates secure room names with random suffix - good security practice
leads.py: _normalize_appointments() properly normalizes all appointment location fields including location_type, physical_address, saysme_meeting_url, other_meeting_url
leads.py: _send_appointment_update_notifications() sends emails to lead primary_email and admin sender - SMTP may not be configured in test environment
email_utils.py: send_email() returns False gracefully when SMTP not configured - no errors thrown
context_for_next_testing_agent: Appointment location dropdown feature is fully implemented and tested. Physical Location shows address field, Online Meeting shows SaySMe + Other checkboxes. SaySMe generates secure room names with format: {cleaned-name}-{random-suffix}. Backend returns appointment_notifications_sent field (0 if SMTP not configured). All existing sections work correctly.
smtp_note: SMTP may not be configured in test environment. appointment_notifications_sent returns 0 which is expected behavior when SMTP is not configured.
